collection.title: Porsche Boxster 2012 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Porsche Boxster 2012 - 2016 (981) model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 23" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment.
